draft.subject: Getting River Analytics' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Sorry we missed each other last week — no problem at all. I saw you brought a teammate into Wrenfield, which is a great first step.

The usual next one is setting up your first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, so it's quick to get moving.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and your teammate, or answer anything over email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
